# Gasses 2 Useful gasses that are the bread and butter of what an experienced atmos is expected to work with.
## Plasma
A flammable gas that is used in many processes on the station.
Engineering uses this gas to generate power and create exotic gasses.
Burning it generates a lot of heat, producing carbon dioxide or tritium.
Plasma gas also has a good specific heat capacity, making it useful for moving heat around.
## Tritium
An extremely flammable radioactive gas.
Tritium is produced when burning plasma in a burn chamber with 97% or more oxygen, saturating plasma with pluoxium, or damaging a supermatter.
The efficiency of tritium fusion depends on various factors such as burn richness and temperature.
## Frezon
One of the common export gasses.
It has an extremely high specific heat capacity, making it excellent for moving large amounts of heat around. Hallucinogenic when inhaled, but causes genetic degredation.
Additionally when exposed to nitrogen above -250 C frezon converts both into nitrous oxide and absorbs massive amounts of energy
Frezon is created by combining 1 tritium with 50 oxygen with a nitrogen catalyst to create 51 frezon. This reaction only occurs at roughly -200 C and below. Paradoxicallly, as the reaction gets colder a percentage of frezon that would be produced is instead replaced with nitrogen.
Frezon can require lots of tuning to stay stable. Remember, atmospherics is all about experimentation and process optimization. Try it until you get it right!
## BZ
A intermediate gas used in many advanced atmospheric reactions.
Although highly sought after, BZ on its own primarily acts as a sleeping agent and hallucinogenic for slime based organisms.
BZ is created by combining 1 nitrous oxide with 2 plasma, but has several quirks that make large scale production difficult.
BZ forms exponentially faster the lower the pressure is and requires large volume to produce in bulk. BZ produces heat on formation, and only forms under 310 K. When there is more than 2 plasma per 1 nitrous oxide, no BZ is produced and instead the nitrous is decomposed.
